featured_reviews.name: Ankita Dodamani
featured_reviews.review_text:
This has been one of the most frustrating courier experiences ever. The service is unprofessional, rigid, and far less reliable than even basic postal services.

Delivery Experience:
My bank ATM card was supposed to be delivered, and since my permanent address is rented out now, I clearly informed the delivery person that I would come personally to collect it. Despite this, he refused to hand it over unless the door was opened — even when I offered valid ID proofs like Aadhaar and PAN.

No Coordination or Common Sense :
This wasn’t even the first time.
On the first attempt, I didn’t receive any call at all, and the package was simply marked “undelivered.” No effort, no communication.

On the second attempt, even after telling him I was coming, he refused to wait for a few minutes saying Room is locked. I told him, it's on rent and tenants might have gone somewhere, I ll come personally and collect it. I ll bring my Identity Card but he didn't pay any attention and returned without even trying. I had to call the tenants, coordinate keys with neighbours, run around unnecessarily — all because the delivery guy was extremely rigid.

Inconsistent Behavior:
What’s worse is that when after managing keys I called him back within maybe 30 minutes, he didn’t even check the door, even though I kept it closed on purpose and stood outside. He handed it over immediately.
So why wasn’t this done on the first attempt when I offered documents and was going to be there physically present?

Past Damaged Parcel – Zero Accountability:
This isn’t my first bad experience with Blue Dart.
About a year ago, I had sent a parcel that arrived completely damaged, ruining a surprise for my family. Despite multiple follow-ups, there was no positive response — calls were ignored, and complaints were cut abruptly.
The lady at the local branch even said, “We are not responsible for any damage,” which shows how little they care about customer parcels or service.

Zero Customer-Centric Approach:
There is absolutely no flexibility, courtesy, or responsibility. Important deliveries are mishandled, communication is poor, and customer concerns are ignored. The overall attitude is dismissive and unprofessional.

Extremely disappointing experience. Unprofessional, uncooperative, and irresponsible service. Whether it’s delivery, communication, or handling parcels, the experience has consistently been bad. One of the worst courier services I’ve dealt with. Even postal service is better than this.

featured_reviews.name: Pournima Kambli
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Experience. During Diwali festival.....Never go to this Mahavir Express Courier Service SV.Road,Borivali West.
They Courier my parcel on 13 th October 2025...from Borivali to Thane, Balkum area as per address..As per Mahavir courier tracking status shows that it reached on 13 th October at night, Thane West Mahavir Express courier...After 2 days 15th & 16th courier tracking status shows that Out for delivery from Thane RO... Majiwada Mahavir Express...but parcel still not received as per Thane balkum address... Friday personally went to Borivali office asking where is the parcel...lady in that office given mobile no of Thane Courier... because Diwali festival parcel delay... manager told me.... Given mobile no of Thane Courier. But no response...On 19th October called to Borivali mangaer he told me collect parcel from Majiwada Mahavir courier because courier having holiday 4 days. Diwali. 19 th October, Sunday, My Brother went to Thane Majiwada Mahavir courier to collect parcel...but no one interested to find that' parcel...waiting for an hour he returned back.. told me worst courier why u send parcel to this courier....After Diwali 24 th October my call received by Ranjit...Thane Manger or Delivery boy don't know asking no and address assured me to send parcel from Majiwada Mahavir courier...
We received the parcel on 25 th October at 1 pm....vey bad condition.. parcel was open n people have ate whatever was inside... empty packets was there...6 items I send to my mother for Diwali...only one pkt received .... Send message about this on WhatsApp Borivali.no .they only reply... sorry' sir....Can Borivali Mangaer give reimbursement against all this.?.. courier charges and Diwali snacks.... They not interested to communicate people. We regularly send any documents or parcel from Anjani courier but this time due to traffic in Thane area or non availability of staff they not accepted parcel... suggest me Mahavir Express Worst courier...so all this happen with me during Diwali festival 😢
..

featured_reviews.name: Paresh Trivedi
featured_reviews.review_text: A courier sent on 16th to Pune is still not received by opposite party and Borivali centre does not even have a clue. When I went personally to enquire ,the person gave me Pune centre's number to enquire. They said that we have returned the envelope to Borivali on 17th itself because they were not allowed to deliver. Borivali branch person could not locate it and started behaving rudely and said that he will revert by evening. Quite unprofessional and rude behaviour. Pathetic service. I will recommend people to avoid them even if they are the last people on earth. I have still not received any communication from them till the evening of 22nd April.

featured_reviews.name: Apollo Eliazer
featured_reviews.review_text:
DON'T USE THIS SERVICE!

My friend posted a very small courier like A4 size envelope on the 13th of August to me in Pune from here.

And today on the 21st of August, when we checked with them as to why the courier wasn't delivered?

Their response was that, they don't deliver to the address sent. This just shows the pathetic service. Even the Indian post office and all commercial courier service delivers here. They were just lying that they don't deliver at the given address.

It is the responsibility of the courier service to first check the pincode and see if they can deliver before they take any package.

But these people are quick to take money and not deliver.

I repeat, don't trust them with your belongings or anything.
